name: Meteor Rock Soul
main_effect:
[Main] Activate 1 of the following effects:
・You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and 4000 DP or less from under your Tamer without paying the cost.
・By unsuspending 1 of your [Shoutmon EX6] and 1 of your [ShootingStarmon], attack a player with 1 of your Digimon.
